draft_en.subject: One question — 16 Port Ethernet Switch
draft_en.body:
Hello,

We have sent you a few mails on "16 Port Ethernet Switch" and you never had a reason to answer — fair enough. No brochure this time, just one question:

For the IP20 DIN-rail unmanaged and managed switches in your industrial-switch portfolio, we can serve as a second ODM source (8-GE + 2 SFP, 8-PoE + 2 SFP; −40~75 °C, CE/RoHS; managed versions on a Marvell platform) from small lots in your housing — which configuration do your automation customers order most?

Reference price: DIN-rail 8-GE + 2 SFP unmanaged industrial switch (STI-280GE) $46 USD EXW, MOQ 1 pc, 15-day validity, 3-year warranty.

If it is not relevant now, a one-word reply is enough and I will take you off the catalog mails.

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
